k:渉.mnemonic: You walk (歩) across the river at the one spot where the water, calm again after the tsunami (氵), is only knee deep. Ford (go cross, transit, ferry).
k:渉.hint: Walking across where it's knee deep.

k:頂.mnemonic: A porter with no hands free puts his tool (具) box on the crown of his skull and balances a page (頁) of orders on top of that. Place on the head (receive, top of head, summit).

k:丈.mnemonic: A tailor lays one (一) rod flat, lets the cloth slide (ノ) along it, and marks the cut with a drop (丶) of chalk. Length (measure).
k:丈.hint: Tailor measuring cloth on a rod.

k:丹.mnemonic: A genius (才) painter needs only a drop (丶) of red lead to turn the whole shrine gate its famous orange-red. Rust-colored (red, red lead, pills).
k:丹.hint: One drop paints the shrine gate.

k:搭.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) grip the handrail as a passenger in a smart suit (合), flowers (艹) in the buttonhole, steps up into the carriage. Board (load a vehicle, ride).

k:茨.mnemonic: You pick the flowers (艹), and the next (次) thing you feel is a row of thorns in your hand. Briar (thorn).

k:齢.mnemonic: The horse dealer orders (令) the mouth open and reads each tooth (歯). The more worn the teeth, the more years. Age.
k:齢.hint: Reading years from a horse's teeth.

k:詰.mnemonic: At New Year everyone squeezes into the shrine to say (言) a wish for good luck (吉), shoulder to shoulder, with not an inch to spare. Packed (close, pressed, reprove).
k:詰.hint: Shoulder to shoulder at the shrine.

k:液.mnemonic: At night (夜) they strike (攵) a tap into the trunk, and by morning the sap has run out like a small tsunami (氵) and filled the bucket. Fluid (liquid, juice, sap).
k:液.hint: Sap running from a tapped trunk.

k:薄.mnemonic: The Dr. (博) brews medicine from flowers (艹), then pours in a tsunami (氵) of water until the tea is pale and has almost no taste. Dilute (thin, weak tea).

k:枠.mnemonic: Cut a tree (木) into nine (九) or ten (十) slats and nail them into a square to go around a picture. Frame (framework, spindle, spool).

k:鏡.mnemonic: A disc of polished gold (金) standing on little legs (儿). Tap it and it rings with a clear sound (音), look into it and you meet your own face. Mirror (speculum).
k:鏡.hint: Polished disc that shows your face.

k:沼.mnemonic: Water from the tsunami (氵) that never drained away. Drop a sword (刀) and the mud closes over it like a mouth (口) and gives nothing back. Marsh (lake, bog, swamp).

k:洗.mnemonic: Before you go ahead (先) into the house, pour a tsunami (氵) of water over your muddy hands and feet. Wash (inquire into, probe).

k:兆.mnemonic: Icicles (冫) hang from both legs (儿) of the scarecrow in the middle of summer. The villagers whisper that something is coming. Portent (trillion, sign, omen).
k:兆.hint: Icicles on a scarecrow in summer.

k:泳.mnemonic: Swept out by the tsunami (氵), you keep stroking and kicking for what feels like an eternity (永) before your feet touch land. Swim.

k:烈.mnemonic: Flames (灬) race along the whole file (列) of torches at once, a roaring line of fire that nothing could put out. Ardent (violent, vehement, furious).
k:烈.hint: Fire racing down a line of torches.

k:縮.mnemonic: The inn (宿) washes your robe in boiling water. Every thread (糸) pulls tight and it comes back child-sized. Shrink (contract, shrivel, wrinkle).
k:縮.hint: Robe back from the inn, child-sized.

k:冠.mnemonic: Take the measurement (寸) around the forehead (冖) of the heir whose line goes back to the origin (元) of the kingdom, so that the gold ring fits. Crown (best, peerless).

k:濃.mnemonic: The run-off from agriculture (農) after a tsunami (氵): water so thick with soil and manure that it is dark brown. Concentrated (thick, dark, undiluted).

k:鶴.mnemonic: A bird (鳥) as tall as the roof (宀), with a red patch on its forehead (冖). Next to it a turkey (隹) looks squat and clumsy. Crane (stork).
k:鶴.hint: Red-capped bird tall as the roof.

k:封.mnemonic: The lid of the jar is packed with soil (土), layer on layer, and a measurement (寸) of wax is pressed on top with the thumb. Nothing gets in or out. Closing (seal).
k:封.hint: Wax pressed on a packed lid.

k:削.mnemonic: A carpenter runs his knife (刂) along the board for a month (月), shavings curling away, until the surface begins to sparkle (⺌). Plane (sharpen, whittle, pare).

k:鼻.mnemonic: A tall stack in the middle of a face. At the top is the tip you tap when you mean yourself, below it wide square nostrils, and at the bottom two streams of breath coming out. Nose (snout).

k:涙.mnemonic: Each re- (戻) run of the sad film brings the same small tsunami (氵) down your cheeks, however many times you have seen it. Tears (sympathy).

k:駒.mnemonic: A horse (馬) so small that one short phrase (句), 'walk on', is all it takes to guide it round the yard. Pony (horse, colt).
k:駒.hint: A horse small enough for two words.

k:伏.mnemonic: In front of the leader (亻), the dog (犬) drops flat on its belly with its chin on the ground. Prostrated (bend down, bow, cover).

k:慶.mnemonic: The long trudge (夂) is over. The winners apply (応) a laurel wreath to each forehead (冖), and the whole crowd cheers and throws its hats. Jubilation (congratulate, rejoice, be happy).

k:捨.mnemonic: Clearing out the old cottage (舎), your fingers (扌) pick up one broken thing after another and toss it on the heap outside. Discard (throw away, abandon, resign).
k:捨.hint: Tossing junk from the old cottage.

k:裕.mnemonic: A cloak (衤) cut so generously that it could cover a whole valley (谷), and there is still cloth to spare. Abundant (rich, fertile).
k:裕.hint: A cloak with cloth to spare.
